newsitem.title: BOSNIA: NATO confiscates illegal Moslem weapons. [CORRECTED 23:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: NATO confiscates illegal Moslem weapons. [CORRECTED 23:40 GMT]

text.p: U.N. police and NATO peace forces confiscated a number of illegal weapons, including mortars and rocket-propelled grenades, from a Bosnian Moslem police station, a NATO spokesman said on Sunday.
(Corrects headline and first paragraph to show that the weapons were confiscated from Bosnian Moslems and not Bosnian Serbs).
"We found material in the Sanski Most police station which one would not ordinarily expect to find in a police station," said Major Brett Boudreau, a NATO spokesman in Sarajevo.
"We confiscated 10 82mm mortars, 45 rpg's and a small amount of ammunition. All of this material will be destroyed."
Boudreau said the arms were discovered during an unannounced inspection of the Sanski Most station. Similar inspections are carried out from time to time across Bosnia.
